data.title: Timeline rows: top epic, its direct children; grandchildren extend their parent's bar; dated tasks with no epic share one last row
data.why: Two levels read at a glance and no date is lost. A dated task without an epic must not appear in the calendar and vanish from the timeline, so it gets a 'No epic' group, epic: null in --json, shown only when it has something dated.
data.rejected: The whole tree: task list --tree already is that; Parentless tasks as top-level rows: buries the epics on a repository with few of them
